pi.name: Assoc. Prof. Tianze WU
pi.title: Principal Investigator | Associate Professor
pi.bio: Dr Tianze Wu is an Associate Professor in the Global Institute of Future Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University. His research focuses on electrocatalysis and sustainable technologies for hydrogen energy and green chemistry. He received his PhD degree in Materials Science and Engineering from Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. Prior to joining Shanghai Jiao Tong University, he worked as a Scientist at the Institute of Sustainability for Chemicals, Energy and Environment (ISCE2), A*STAR Singapore, and later as a NTU Presidential Postdoctoral Fellow at School of Materials Science and Engineering, NTU.
awards: 2023 - Singapore MTC Young Individual Research Grant (YIRG) Award
2022 - Chinese Government Award for Outstanding Self-financed Students Abroad

lead_architect.name: Kevin ZHAO Weiming
lead_architect.title: Chief AI Architect
lead_architect.bio: Kevin ZHAO Weiming is the Chief AI Architect of EC-ZERO Lab at the Global Institute of Future Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University. He leads the lab’s AI architecture, research toolchains, and intelligent lab infrastructure. His work focuses on applying generative AI, computer vision, human-computer interaction, and extended reality to electrochemical research, smart laboratories, and engineering practice. Before joining EC-ZERO, he served as Director of the XR Lab at the SJTU Student Innovation Center and worked as a Research Associate at the Energy Research Institute @ NTU (ERI@N), Singapore. He holds an MSc in Digital Media Technology from Nanyang Technological University and a BSc in Computer Science and Technology from Northwest University.
